notes: One lane = one model reached through one harness, drawing on one usage meter from scripts/usage.py.

burn = 0.75*input + 0.25*output USD per Mtok at API list price (agentic work is input-heavy). Subscription meters drain in proportion to list-price cost, so burn predicts meter drain per token; live pace (weekly remaining / cycle fraction remaining, from usage.py) decides between eligible lanes; r = min(5h, weekly) is the gate and the rebalance line only.
tie_band is measured on score (pace); rebalance and gate on r. Weekly cycles are assumed 7 days (usage.py WEEK).

Prices verified 2026-09-02: Anthropic (claude-api skill table, cached 2026-06-24), OpenAI developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, xAI docs.x.ai/docs/models, Google ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (through 2026-12-31).
ASSUMPTION: agy meters Claude/GPT-OSS models at Anthropic list price; unverified against Google's own accounting.
Each lane wins at least one class; each class lists its eligible lanes in pin order. A lane that wins nothing gets no row.

lead.shape: plan, live-context debugging, adjudication, final synthesis. The session; never delegated.

design.shape: spec amendment, splitting a large plan, synthesis over large inputs

review.shape: independent review of a diff. Rule: reviewer family != author family.

impl.shape: self-contained implementation, tests, refactor with a clear spec

verify.shape: refute, verify, standards check, critic, revise

scout.shape: finder, grounding, search and summarize, research legwork

mechanical.shape: renames, formatting, high-volume transforms, extraction, scaffolding

browser.shape: route by evals/browser/_profile.md, then classify the reasoning part as above

council.shape: the council skill; quorum >= 2 families besides the lead
